blocks.text: Śiva Sūtras 1.20
blocks.directed: [long pause] Śiva Sūtras 1.20

blocks.text: भूतसन्धानभूतपृथक्त्वविश्वसङ्घट्टाः
blocks.directed: [slowly] भूतसन्धानभूतपृथक्त्वविश्वसङ्घट्टाः

blocks.text: Bhūtasandhāna-bhūtapṛthaktva-viśvasaṅghaṭṭāḥ.
blocks.directed: Bhūtasandhāna-bhūtapṛthaktva-viśvasaṅghaṭṭāḥ.

blocks.text: The joining of existents, their separation, and the bringing together of the universe.
blocks.directed: The joining of existents, their separation, and the bringing together of the universe.

blocks.text: Congratulations, You’re Now Playing Minecraft With Reality.
blocks.directed: Congratulations, You’re Now Playing Minecraft With Reality.

blocks.text: Here come more siddhis.
blocks.directed: Here come more siddhis.

blocks.text: Three broad forms of extraordinary accomplishment are presented.
blocks.directed: Three broad forms of extraordinary accomplishment are presented.

blocks.text: First, bhūtasandhāna.
blocks.directed: First, bhūtasandhāna.

blocks.text: The bringing together or integration of existent things.
blocks.directed: The bringing together or integration of existent things.

blocks.text: Second, bhūtapṛthaktva.
blocks.directed: Second, bhūtapṛthaktva.

blocks.text: Their separation or differentiation.
blocks.directed: Their separation or differentiation.

blocks.text: Third, viśvasaṅghaṭṭa.
blocks.directed: Third, viśvasaṅghaṭṭa.

blocks.text: The bringing together of things throughout the universe.
blocks.directed: The bringing together of things throughout the universe.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja associates these with powers affecting bodies and other entities, including their integration, separation, and the apprehension of otherwise distant things.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja associates these with powers affecting bodies and other entities, including their integration, separation, and the apprehension of otherwise distant things.

blocks.text: Yes, the actual traditional interpretation includes extraordinary abilities. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.
blocks.directed: Yes, the actual traditional interpretation includes extraordinary abilities. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.

blocks.text: But what is their philosophical significance?
blocks.directed: But what is their philosophical significance?

blocks.text: Return to the beginning.
blocks.directed: Return to the beginning.

blocks.text: The universe manifests through Śakti.
blocks.directed: The universe manifests through Śakti.

blocks.text: Differentiation arises through the powers of consciousness.
blocks.directed: Differentiation arises through the powers of consciousness.

blocks.text: And limitations associated with space, time, agency and knowledge constitute the contracted experience of the individual.
blocks.directed: And limitations associated with space, time, agency and knowledge constitute the contracted experience of the individual.

blocks.text: From the standpoint of the tradition, a yogi established in the supreme source of those powers is no longer understood as subject to ordinary limitation in the same way.
blocks.directed: From the standpoint of the tradition, a yogi established in the supreme source of those powers is no longer understood as subject to ordinary limitation in the same way.

blocks.text: Hence the claims about siddhis.
blocks.directed: Hence the claims about siddhis.

blocks.text: But there is an important hierarchy here.
blocks.directed: But there is an important hierarchy here.

blocks.text: The extraordinary abilities are not the fundamental definition of liberation.
blocks.directed: The extraordinary abilities are not the fundamental definition of liberation.

blocks.text: Recognition of one’s true nature is more fundamental than the acquisition of unusual capabilities.
blocks.directed: Recognition of one’s true nature is more fundamental than the acquisition of unusual capabilities.

blocks.text: Otherwise, the goal of spiritual life would simply become accumulating supernatural party tricks.
blocks.directed: Otherwise, the goal of spiritual life would simply become accumulating supernatural party tricks.

blocks.text: You could assemble worlds, separate elements, perceive distant things—
blocks.directed: You could assemble worlds, separate elements, perceive distant things—

blocks.text: And still spend your afternoon being annoyed because somebody didn’t reply to your message.
blocks.directed: And still spend your afternoon being annoyed because somebody didn’t reply to your message.

blocks.text: Quite an achievement.
blocks.directed: Quite an achievement.
